weekend_note: Warm and mostly dry Thursday and Friday (low 80s), then showers move in for Halloween weekend, with Sunday looking wetter than Saturday and a stormier day possible Wednesday. Picks: Taste of the Beach (free festival Saturday), the Palafox Halloween Market and Boo at the Zoo on Saturday, Rocky Horror at Pensacola Little Theatre starting Friday, The Lacs at the fair Saturday night, and Ice Flyers hockey indoors at the Bay Center. Isaias recovery is still affecting some events, so double-check before heading out.

news.title: FEMA public assistance approved for Northwest Florida after Isaias
news.summary: Public assistance money is flowing to local governments, with Pensacola reporting about $25 million in damage to city facilities. Aid for individual residents is still under review.

news.title: Disaster declaration approved, individual assistance still pending
news.summary: Officials say damage assessments continue and residents can still report property damage through county links; a lawmaker expects Escambia and Santa Rosa approval soon.

news.title: Pelican opens on W Nine Mile Road
news.summary: The restaurant, bar and liquor store began a soft opening Oct 19, with a grand opening planned Nov 7.

news.title: Pensacola Interstate Fair runs through Nov 1
news.summary: The fair opened on schedule despite storm damage at the grounds; organizers said canceling was not feasible because the ride company had later commitments.

news.title: A&E Fabrics and Crafts to close after storm damage
news.summary: The 1954 store on New Warrington Road is closing for good after roof damage and plans to retire.

news.title: TSA PreCheck enrollment at Pensacola airport Nov 3 to 6
news.summary: Daily enrollment 9 AM to noon and 1 to 5 PM; the fee is $76.75 for five years.

news.title: Pensacola Beach and Perdido Key access after Isaias
news.summary: Public beaches are open, though some Pensacola Beach access points are closed and Fort Pickens has temporary closures.

coverage_note: Written early Thursday, Oct 29. Temperatures come from Weather Underground's 10-day page, which gives rainfall amounts rather than percentages, so rain chances are carried from FOX10 for Oct 31 and Nov 1 and are my rough estimates for the other days. Local Pulse, WEAR's listing page and NorthEscambia.com could not be opened this run, so Gonzalez, Molino, Beulah and Cantonment items are carried over and not reconfirmed, and no new north-county events were found. Weekend updates came from Must Do Pensacola's Halloween guide and weekly list and the PensacolaBeach.com air show page. Ice Flyers dates, the Saenger shows and later November events are carried over from earlier runs. Casa Luvia's opening rests on a headline only.
